title: Coefficient forgetting respects underived exchange
statement: For any commutative square of schemes and any module-valued etale sheaf F, the underlying abelian map of module baseChangeMap followed by the direct-image evaluation identity and the inverse g′ coefficient mate equals the inverse g coefficient mate followed by g inverse image of the f evaluation identity and abelian baseChangeMap. The maps are the fixed moduleAbelianLowerStarIso and moduleAbelianUpperStarIso from lem-weil-pbc-module-abelian-derived-direct-image-comparison; no cartesianness is required.

source.place: Remark 07A7, adjunction-mate construction; Tags 03D2 and 03D3 for coefficient inverse image.

proof.text: Apply the g abelian adjunction bijection to forward compatibility. The coefficient mate identity identifies its unit composite with the forgotten module unit. Apply unit_map_baseChangeMap_app for both coefficient categories. Pushforward square isomorphisms commute definitionally with forgetting. Naturality of squareLowerStarIso and the g′ mate unit identity identify the adjoints. Injectivity proves forward compatibility.
Compose with the inverse g and g′ coefficient comparisons; cancel their hom/inv composites and map the latter through f′ direct image. Insert the identity direct-image comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleAbelianUnderivedExchange_compatibility
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    (moduleAbelianForget Λ Y').map ((baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq).app F) ≫
        (moduleAbelianLowerStarIso Λ f').hom.app ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F) ≫
        ((f')_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map ((moduleAbelianUpperStarIso Λ g').inv.app F) =
      (moduleAbelianUpperStarIso Λ g).inv.app ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F) ≫
        ((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map ((moduleAbelianLowerStarIso Λ f).hom.app F) ≫
        (baseChangeMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq).app ((moduleAbelianForget Λ X).obj F)
